title: Zero-Waste Living: Habits for Beginners
description: Lối sống giảm thiểu rác thải: từ bình nước cá nhân đến túi mua sắm tái sử dụng.

coreVocabulary.contextSentence: Sustainable habits are small actions repeated consistently over years.
Refusing single-use plastic cups and straws protects ocean life.
Cloth tote bags are an ideal substitute for plastic shopping bags.
